title: Social practice theory (25 codes)
label: practice code
direction_note: Relative to the practice the passage is about: does what it describes make or renew the links that hold the practice together, or break them? (Shove et al. 2012: 21, 36)
sources: Giddens 1984, The Constitution of Society, ch. 1
Nicolini 2012, Practice Theory, Work, and Organization, ch. 3.1 and ch. 9
Shove, Pantzar and Watson 2012, The Dynamics of Social Practice, ch. 2-3
Spaargaren, Lamers and Weenink 2016, Practice Theory and Research, ch. 1
stance: Programmatic eclecticism (Nicolini 2012: 213): Shove and Schatzki for elements and materials, Giddens for knowing, rules and resources, Nicolini for zooming in and out. Sensitising concepts, not a formula (Nicolini 2012: 240).
